claims.claim: About 1.5 million people in Kenya may be affected by forecast above-normal rainfall from October to December, and up to 500,000 may be forced to leave their homes.
claims.episode_span: About 1.5 million people in Kenya may be affected by forecast above-normal rainfall from October to December, and up to 500,000 residents may be forced to leave their homes
claims.source_title: In Kenya, 1.5 million people may be affected by El Niño rains — Nation Kenya
claims.supporting_quote: In Kenya, about 1.5 million people may be affected by forecast above-normal rainfall from October to December, while up to 500,000 residents may be forced to leave their homes.

claims.claim: Authorities identified Nairobi, Kisumu, Busia and Mandera as the four counties at highest risk, and the National Disaster Operations Centre said 18 counties are concerned.
claims.episode_span: Authorities have identified Nairobi, Kisumu, Busia and Mandera as the four counties at highest risk.
claims.source_title: In Kenya, 1.5 million people may be affected by El Niño rains — Nation Kenya
claims.supporting_quote: As Nation Kenya reports , authorities have identified Nairobi, Kisumu, Busia and Mandera as the four counties at the highest risk from the consequences of El Niño-related rains.

claims.claim: David Samoei said preparations began after the Kenya Meteorological Department warned of above-normal rainfall, and the centre coordinated rescue centres and safe shelters.
claims.episode_span: preparations began after the Kenya Meteorological Department warned of the likelihood of above-normal rainfall
claims.source_title: In Kenya, 1.5 million people may be affected by El Niño rains — Nation Kenya
claims.supporting_quote: According to Samoei, preparations began after the Kenya Meteorological Department warned of the likelihood of above-normal rainfall.

claims.claim: Project BRIDGE is to deploy 90,000 kilometres of open-access fibre across Nigeria's 36 states by 2028, lifting the backbone from about 35,000 kilometres to around 125,000 and connecting more than 200,000 public institutions.
claims.episode_span: Project BRIDGE is to deploy 90,000 kilometres of open-access fibre across Nigeria's 36 states by 2028
claims.source_title: Nigeria's digital project to deliver 90,000 kilometres of fibre across 36 States by 2028 - Yilwatda
claims.supporting_quote: When completed, the project is expected to take Nigeria’s combined backbone from about 35,000 kilometres to around 125,000 kilometres and connect more than 200,000 schools, health facilities and other public institutions in the country.

claims.claim: Yilwatda said about $800 million in sovereign financing had been secured, from the World Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the African Development Bank, plus a €22 million EU grant, with rollout scheduled to start in October 2026 and finish in 2028.
claims.episode_span: about $800 million in sovereign financing had been secured: $500 million from the World Bank, $100 million from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and $200 million from the African Development Bank, plus a €22 million grant from the European Union
claims.source_title: Nigeria's digital project to deliver 90,000 kilometres of fibre across 36 States by 2028 - Yilwatda
claims.supporting_quote: The APC National Chairman disclosed that about $800 million in sovereign financing had already been secured for the initiative, comprising $500 million from the World Bank, $100 million from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and $200 million from the African Development Bank, in addition to a €22 million grant from the European Union.

claims.claim: Gaza's health authorities say at least 1,400 Palestinians, including women and children, have been killed since the 10 October 2025 ceasefire phase took effect, while the Israeli military says strikes targeted Hamas militants and Hamas denies attempting to rearm.
claims.episode_span: Gaza's health authorities say at least 1,400 Palestinians, including women and children, have been killed since the ceasefire took effect.
claims.source_title: One year after Gaza ceasefire: A truce without a clear path to peace
claims.supporting_quote: Gaza's health authorities say at least 1,400 Palestinians, including women and children, have been killed since the ceasefire took effect.

claims.claim: The Yellow Line initially placed around 53 percent of Gaza under Israeli control, and CGTN reports Israel now effectively controls roughly two-thirds, with around two million Palestinians confined to a shrinking coastal strip.
claims.episode_span: The Yellow Line initially placed around 53 percent of Gaza under Israeli control; CGTN reports Israel now effectively controls roughly two-thirds
claims.source_title: One year after Gaza ceasefire: A truce without a clear path to peace
claims.supporting_quote: The so-called Yellow Line established under the first phase of the ceasefire initially placed around 53% of Gaza under Israeli control. Israel now effectively controls roughly two-thirds of the territory.

claims.claim: Saudi authorities reported 12 killed and 309 injured in the Saturday strike on King Khalid International Airport; Reuters reported a Houthi claim and the Associated Press reported no immediate group statement.
claims.episode_span: Saudi authorities reported 12 dead and 309 injured in Saturday's strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport; Reuters reported a Houthi claim of responsibility and the Associated Press reported no immediate statement
claims.source_title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia test US deterrence… What do flight data reveal?
claims.supporting_quote: Saudi authorities reported that 12 people were killed and 309 others injured in the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday, October 10, according to Reuters and the Associated Press.

claims.claim: Coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki Al Malik said the coalition would respond decisively, Trump said the US may join Saudi strikes, and Flightradar24 said the airport closure runs until 1am Monday.
claims.episode_span: Maj Gen Turki Al Malik said the Saudi-led coalition would respond decisively
claims.source_title: Saudi-led coalition vows to ‘respond decisively’ to deadly Riyadh airport attack
claims.supporting_quote: The Saudi-led coalition vowed to “respond decisively” to a Houthi attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport that killed 12 people, wounded more than 300 and drew widespread international condemnation.

claims.claim: Deborah Phehla died after swallowing debris her file had warned she would eat without supervision, following relocation from a Life Esidimeni facility, and the WHO is calling for lived experience to shape mental-health decisions this month.
claims.episode_span: Deborah Phehla, who died after a warning in her file was not acted on when she was moved out of a Life Esidimeni facility
claims.source_title: Lived experience can connect the healthcare dots when it gets a say
claims.supporting_quote: Deborah Phehla died choking on the paper, cardboard and plastic she had swallowed.

claims.claim: On 29 July 2026, 1,386 AI workers from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Meta signed a statement calling for tools to slow AI development if necessary, while company leaders had supported Executive Order 14179.
claims.episode_span: 1,386 AI workers from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Meta
claims.source_title: Of agents and agency — A local AI policy must work to serve us
claims.supporting_quote: On 29 July 2026, 1,386 AI workers from leading tech companies, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Meta, signed a statement calling for international cooperation to develop the technical and governance tools needed to slow AI development if necessary.

claims.claim: Relebohile Mofokeng scored a brace in South Africa's 5-0 win over Eritrea, his first two international goals, as Bafana Bafana opened 2027 Afcon qualifying with two wins under Pitso Mosimane.
